{{hatnote|For the [[Outer Rim Scout]] card and the Outer Rim region of organized play, see those articles.}}
[[File:The Outer Rim SandCrawler banner.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Homepage banner, GeoCities account ev9d11.]]
'''The Outer Rim''' was a Las Vegas GeoCities fan site for [[Star Wars CCG]], [[Young Jedi]], Jedi Knights TCG, and Star Trek CCG. The account was <code>geocities.com/ev9d11/</code>. The SWCCG section used the name The Outer Rim; the Young Jedi section used Young Jedi Deck Effect.<ref name="home">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/ The Outer Rim : SandCrawler], GeoCities (homepage). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021127165521/http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="swidx">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/SWindexhome.htm SW Alliance Jump Station], The Outer Rim. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010806052101/http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/SWindexhome.htm Internet Archive]</ref> A third-party mirror of the same files is live on geocities.ws.<ref name="homews">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/ The Outer Rim : SandCrawler] (geocities.ws). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029232124/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/ Internet Archive]</ref>

The disclaimer line dated the SWCCG material © 1998 THE OUTER RIM SWCCG.<ref name="home" /> Young Jedi material is © 2000 YOUNG JEDI DECK EFFECT, Jedi Knights © 2000 JEDI KNIGHTS DECK MASTERS, and Star Trek © 2000 STARTREK OUTPOST.<ref name="home" /> Dated homepage update lines on the surviving capture are 12 May (SWCCG), 19 May (Jedi Knights), and 20 May (Young Jedi).<ref name="home" /> The same capture said the [[Tatooine]] expansion was set to release on 30 May, which places that freeze in 2001.<ref name="home" />

== Staff ==

The homepage listed four contacts:<ref name="home" />

* '''The Mercenary''' (JCM), also billed as Outlander Mercenary on the Young Jedi interviews index.<ref name="yjiv">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/YoungJedi/Interviews/interviews.htm Deck Effect YJ Interviews], Young Jedi Deck Effect. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011122015220/http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/YoungJedi/Interviews/interviews.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''The Information Broker''' (SM), the SWCCG-side contact on the Alliance Jump Station.<ref name="swidx" />
* '''Tusken Sniper''', listed as a contact.
* '''Merlin''', listed as a contact.

[[Patrick Sullivan]] closed his 5 December 2000 interview with "Thanks for the questions, Avery."<ref name="yjiv" /> [[Avery Poliak]] of Las Vegas reached the [[Young Jedi]] World Championship final at [[DecipherCon 2000]].<ref name="tr-d1317">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-info-brokers-dcon-day-one-reportd1317/ info-brokers-dcon-day-one-report], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 10 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-info-brokers-dcon-day-one-reportd1317/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026023124/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-info-brokers-dcon-day-one-reportd1317/ Internet Archive]</ref> [[Tim Guzman]] wrote as Info Broker on DeckTech and as Gold 117 on Decipher's squadron list. The Young Jedi Deck Effect index lists him for the Nevada Grand Slam, 2000.<ref name="yjiv" />

== SWCCG section ==

[[File:The Outer Rim Alliance Jump Station.jpg|thumb|right|280px|SW Alliance Jump Station banner for the SWCCG index.]]

The SWCCG index is titled SW Alliance Jump Station.<ref name="swidx" /> It grouped decks by set, submission forms, articles, recent rulings, Ask The Senate, Ask Yoda, Las Vegas tournament listings, and constructed ratings.<ref name="swidx" />

=== Decks ===

The surviving indexes are:

* '''Expanded Universe''' — three Rebel lists by Skali: ''X-Wing Hidden Base'', ''Speederz Rulez'', and ''Watch Your Step''.<ref name="eu">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/ExpandedDeckList.htm Expanded Universe], The Outer Rim. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010806053647/http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/ExpandedDeckList.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''DS II & Beyond''' — constructed lists under [[Premiere - Death Star II]] and later, including titles by The Information Broker ([[Tim Guzman]]), [[Joe Horbey]], Dane Morrison, SOC, DS-61-4, [[Chris Bentley]], [[Andrew Meyer]], Christinus, Salacious Crumb, Chris Vanderlaan, [[Tony Harris]], Admiral Thrawn, Kosh, Lavinge, B., Matt Sutherland, Cantina Joe, [[Dan Christy]], Archie Kujawski, [[Kelvin Lok]], Steiner 750, and Aaron Silvers.<ref name="ds2">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/forcedecks.html DS II & Beyond], The Outer Rim. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155334/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/forcedecks.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Pre Special Ed''' — linked from the index as <code>TheOuterRim/cdeck/Decks.html</code>.

Reading copies of the surviving SWCCG 60s are at [[The Outer Rim decks]]. Young Jedi lists stay on the archived HTML.

=== Ratings and local play ===

The SWCCG index linked Las Vegas tournament listings and constructed ratings.<ref name="swidx" />

== Young Jedi Deck Effect ==

The homepage dated Young Jedi Deck Effect © 2000 and carried a 20 May Young Jedi update line.<ref name="home" /> The interviews index is the surviving Deck Effect interviews listing.<ref name="yjiv" /> Young Jedi lists stay on the archived HTML, as on [[Young Jedi]].

=== Interviews ===

Young Jedi Deck Effect published eight player interviews in 2000. Full copies of the SWCCG players' interviews are on the player pages and indexed at [[Interviews]].<ref name="yjiv" />

Ian Vincent won the 2000 Young Jedi World Championship at [[DecipherCon 2000]]. The Hooper and Vincent interviews stay on the archived HTML.

== Jedi Knights, Star Trek, and other games ==

The combined account also hosted Jedi Knights Deck Masters (theme decks from The Mercenary), a Star Trek Outpost, a New Year Bash microsite, and 2001 Nevada States pages.
